# Arc

> Arc is a purely AOT-compiled systems programming language with idiomatic C# surface syntax, Rust-style memory safety, compile-time LINQ/`Expression<T>`, and no stop-the-world GC. Official public repo: https://github.com/Arc-Future/Arc (MIT). Not Cratis/Arc or other same-named projects.

This file is the canonical map for AI agents and documentation crawlers. Prefer linked Markdown sources over HTML scrapes. **Publishable developer handbook** lives under `docs/arc/` (Docbit slug). Language book body is primarily Chinese; READMEs are bilingual (English default). RFCs under `docs/rfc/` are design authority — not the default publish set.

## Start here

- [English README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Arc-Future/Arc/main/README.md): positioning, comparison, quick start
- [Chinese README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Arc-Future/Arc/main/README.zh.md): 中文入口
- [Developer handbook INDEX](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Arc-Future/Arc/main/docs/arc/INDEX.md): official publishable TOC
- [Foreword](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Arc-Future/Arc/main/docs/arc/FOREWORD.md)
- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Arc-Future/Arc/main/docs/arc/02-quickstart/getting-started.md): install SDK or build from source
- [Build & run](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Arc-Future/Arc/main/docs/arc/02-quickstart/build-run.md): `arc check` / `build` / `run`
- [CHANGELOG](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Arc-Future/Arc/main/CHANGELOG.md): version history (current line 0.1)

## Project facts

- Extension: `.as` · CLI: `arc` · License: MIT · Version line: 0.1
- Compiler bootstrap: Rust (`crates/*`) · Codegen: LLVM 22+
- Rendering (Arc.UI): wgpu only — no software-raster fallback
- Publish upload root: `docs/arc/` → `<app_base>/docs/arc/`
- Releases: https://github.com/Arc-Future/Arc/releases
- Security: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Arc-Future/Arc/main/SECURITY.md
- Contributing: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Arc-Future/Arc/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
